name: machineproof-settlement
description: Chainlink CRE workflow: independently verifies a MachineProof robot execution proof and settles the escrow on-chain

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.live.json
scripts.cre:simulate: cd .. && cre workflow simulate ./machineproof-settlement -T local-simulation --broadcast --listen --limits none
